Technical SEO.title: Google Local Knowledge Panel As An AI Overview
Technical SEO.summary: Google is converting local knowledge panels and Google Business Profile listings into AI Overview-style entries, with a Show More button that expands into an AI Mode chat interface. This is a significant structural change for local and travel brands managing Google Business Profiles.

Technical SEO.title: Google Updates Mediapartners-Google Crawler Guidance: Less About AdSense
Technical SEO.summary: Google has expanded its Mediapartners-Google crawler documentation to cover more than just AdSense, signaling broader use of this crawler. Enterprise SEOs managing crawl budgets and crawler directives should review updated guidance.

Technical SEO.title: What Ever Happened To Google Discover On Desktop
Technical SEO.summary: Google had announced and begun rolling out Discover on desktop in 2025, but the feature has since disappeared and is no longer found on Google.com desktop. This affects content teams optimizing for Discover as a traffic channel.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Citation Test Finds Source Order Matters Less Than It Looks
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A controlled test found that the order of sources in AI citation outputs mattered less than raw data implied, and that structured content rewrites shifted how citation credit was distributed across sources. This has direct implications for GEO content strategy focused on earning AI citations.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: I Made My Website Charge AI Agents A Penny Per Page, Then I Watched Claude Pay It
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: An experiment charging AI crawlers per page found that major bots such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and Googlebot do not currently pay, and that enabling such paywalls risks losing AI citations. The piece frames the tension between monetizing crawler access and maintaining AI search visibility.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Does My Product Page Copy Still Matter If Agents Read Feeds And Schema?
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that product page copy remains important for building shopper trust and filling informational gaps that AI feeds and schema alone do not cover. Relevant for enterprise travel and automotive teams balancing structured data with on-page content.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Reddit AI Search Picks Already-Popular Comments, Audit Finds
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: An audit of Reddit AI search found that formal, highly upvoted comments were selected more frequently, while experiential or colloquial language appeared less often in AI-surfaced results. Brands monitoring user-generated content and forum presence for GEO signals should note this selection bias.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media analyzed over 13,000 citations across four AI tools to identify which domains and content types are most frequently referenced in AI-generated answers. This is directly actionable research for enterprise teams building GEO and LLM visibility strategies.

AI Search / GEO.title: Position: Generative Engine Optimization Creates Underexamined Risks, Governance Must Target Concentration, Disclosure, and Academic Blind Spots
AI Search / GEO.summary: An academic paper argues that GEO practices introduce underexamined risks including source concentration and lack of disclosure, and calls for governance frameworks targeting these blind spots. Enterprise SEOs pursuing AI visibility should be aware of the regulatory and ethical dimensions emerging around GEO.

AI Search / GEO.title: PeakMetrics Launches AI Perceptions, a New GEO Platform Purpose-Built for Communications Teams
AI Search / GEO.summary: PeakMetrics has launched a GEO platform called AI Perceptions, designed specifically for communications teams to monitor and manage brand visibility in generative AI outputs. This represents a growing vendor category relevant to enterprise AI search monitoring workflows.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering Generative Engine Optimization in 2026: Full Guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land published a comprehensive guide to GEO practices in 2026, covering how to optimize content for visibility in generative AI answer surfaces. Sourced from a top-tier industry publication, making it a reliable reference for enterprise GEO strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: IF-GEO: Conflict-Aware Instruction Fusion for Multi-Query Generative Engine Optimization
AI Search / GEO.summary: A research paper introduces IF-GEO, a method for handling conflicting instructions across multiple queries in generative engine optimization, addressing a technical challenge relevant to enterprise-scale GEO implementation. Useful background for SEO managers building scalable GEO frameworks.

AI Search / GEO.title: 3 Predictions For 2027, And Why You Wont Be Able To Check Them
AI Search / GEO.summary: The piece argues that the surface that ranks in search and the surface that earns revenue are decoupling, offering three forward-looking predictions about Google in 2027 and the measurability challenges that will follow. Relevant for enterprise SEOs planning long-term AI search and GEO strategy.
